# Ahmad El Lahib – Freelance App & Website Developer (Lebanon, remote worldwide)

> Ahmad El Lahib is a senior software developer based in Baabda, Lebanon, available remotely worldwide, with 12+ years of experience (since 2014). He builds native Android apps (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), Windows desktop apps (C#, .NET, WPF) and fast, mobile-friendly websites for businesses in Beirut and across Lebanon, and uses AI-assisted development and AI features in his work. Languages: Arabic, English, French.

Contact: ahmad@ahmadellahib.dev · WhatsApp +961 71 312 535 · https://ahmadellahib.dev/
Not offered as a freelance service: POS, payment, card or vending-payment apps.

## Services

- [Freelance Android App Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/android-app-developer-lebanon/): native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps for businesses in Beirut and across Lebanon.
- [Freelance Website Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/website-developer-lebanon/): fast, mobile-friendly company websites, landing pages and web apps.
- [Freelance Windows App Developer in Lebanon](https://ahmadellahib.dev/windows-app-developer-lebanon/): C#, .NET and WPF apps for back-office work, dashboards and tools that connect to printers, scanners and serial or USB devices.
- [Hire a remote Android developer](https://ahmadellahib.dev/hire-remote-android-developer/): works remotely with teams in Europe, the Gulf and North America on Beirut time (UTC+2/+3), in English, Arabic and French; fixed price or day rate. Arabic version for Gulf clients: https://ahmadellahib.dev/ar/hire-remote-android-developer/
- [Freelance Kotlin Multiplatform developer](https://ahmadellahib.dev/kotlin-multiplatform-developer/): one Kotlin codebase for Android and iOS (Compose Multiplatform), shipped in production.
- [Arabic app developer: RTL and Arabic localization](https://ahmadellahib.dev/arabic-rtl-app-developer/): native Arabic speaker; right-to-left audits and bilingual Arabic/English apps and websites.

## Quick facts

- Based in Baabda (Mount Lebanon), works with businesses in Beirut, across Lebanon and remotely. Replies within one working day.
- Typical 2026 freelance price ranges in Lebanon (not a quote): company website $400–1,500; simple app $2,000–5,000; business app with backend and dashboard $5,000–15,000; multi-role app (customer, driver, manager) $15,000–35,000+; yearly upkeep about 10–20% of the build cost. Details: https://ahmadellahib.dev/blog/app-development-cost-lebanon/
- Builds bilingual Arabic/English apps and websites with proper right-to-left layout.
- Clients own the code, the domain and the store accounts.
- Senior Android developer since 2014 (12+ years); Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, C#/.NET/WPF, web.
